title: v5.1.21 — Leaderboards Alive
message: Leaderboards are no longer empty — each game has 12 seeded players (ChipMaster, HighRoller, JackpotJane and friends) so you can see where you stack up. Your own score merges in and re-sorts automatically. Signed-out players can now browse the leaderboard without signing in. Small shop polish: Card Themes buy button now says 'Buy' like the other sections.
